component: Document and Window receivers in the property port

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original port captures the spell dialog's previous focus with window.opener.document.activeElement, rather than adding documentGlobal to the opener Window. Its tab-browser helper also keeps a mixed wrapper-or-Window fallback: ownerGlobal ?? nativeTabInfo, then getBrowser when available. Fixed accepted source retains both forms. These concrete exceptions show why a port must check the actual receiver; they do not define a global ban on ownerGlobal or prove paired native property semantics. Focus capture/restoration is static source scope only.
title: Spell-dialog opener access stays direct while tab lookup retains a Window fallback
